messages.subject: add jar packages to classPath from a directory
messages.subject_clean: add jar packages to classPath from a directory
messages.body_plain:
I found when using rJava to scrape data from web pages and other task 
where java had packages the R does not, I needed to load multiple jars 
to the classpath.  This was tedious to code and maintain  I created the 
following method to load all jar files in a directory.  This made my 
life significantly easier when I had automated tasks and building new 
rJava applications.   I wanted to share it with you and if the team 
wants,  please include this in the package.

Have a great day.
Joe
#' 
==============================================================================
#' Name   : setJarClasses
#' Author : Joe W. Byers
#' Date   : 08/13/2014
#' Version: 1.0001
#' Aim    : add jar packages to classPath from a directory. Default dir 
= /usr/share/java
#' Mail   : <<<ecjbosu at aol.com>>>
#' License: GPL-3
#' 
==============================================================================

setJarClasses <-function (jardir='/usr/share/java'){
require(rJava);

.jinit()
#load jars
#jar directory
#put in a system cache database
jarfiles = list.files(jardir, all.files = F, full.names = T, 
include.dirs=F);

ret=lapply(jarfiles, function(x) .jaddClassPath(x));
ret = .jclassPath();

#detach("package:rJava");
return(ret);

}


-- 
*Joe W. Byers*

messages.subject: method not found when calling POI method lockSort() with .jcall
messages.subject_clean: method not found when calling POI method lockSort() with .jcall
messages.body_plain:
I tried to unlock sort in an excel sheet.

There is an POI method lockSort, and it is declared as:

public void lockSort(boolean enabled)

https://poi.apache.org/apidocs/org/apache/poi/xssf/usermodel/XSSFSheet.html#lockSort(boolean)

When I call the function with

rJava::.jcall(sheet, "V", "lockSort"), it is ok and working.

But when I call it with:

rJava::.jcall(sheet, "V", "lockSort", FALSE)

It gives error: method lockSort with signature (Z)V not found.

I am new to R and knowing little about JAVA, please let me know what is the right way
to pass FALSE boolean.

Gang Chen
